UILabel.textAlignment in UIAlertController is hardcoded to .center, so the paragraph style trick where I'm setting it to .leading won't work there.

As a side effect of removing the carrot with permittedArrowDirections = [], the  popover will be placed on top of the button because the system has no idea where it should be displayed. Alternatively we can use permittedArrowDirections = [.up, .down] so we don't see it on the side
